div.span: 3. GUIDED CROSS-SCALE FUSION (Coloring Inside Sharp Outlines)
1. NATIVE SATELLITE INPUTS (TriSpec: No early bicubic stretching)

span.br:
Blurring 2.5m output through satellite lens model (MTF)
MUST match raw 10m, 20m, 60m sensor readings
Split Specialized Heads: VIS (RGB) | Red-Edge/NIR | SWIR
10m bands: Low σ² | 20m: Medium σ² | 60m: High σ²

• 60m → 20m (guided by 20m spectral features)
• 20m → 10m (10m B4/B8 sharp outlines allocate 20m colors)

• DWT splits coarse (LL) and fine edges (HF)
• 2D Visual State Space (VSSD Mamba)

• Band tokens embedded by physical wavelength (nm)
• Bidirectional Spectral Mamba + Graph Mixer

div.span:
10m High-Res Bands (4 Bands)
B2 (Blue), B3 (Green), B4 (Red), B8 (NIR)
Sharp geometry & boundaries

20m Red-Edge & SWIR (6 Bands)
B5, B6, B7, B8A, B11, B12
Vegetation red-edge & soil moisture

60m Atmospheric (2 Bands)
B1 (Coastal Aerosol), B9 (Water Vapor)
Atmospheric haze & vapor context

span.br:
Spatial VSSD Mamba +
Spectral Wavelength Mamba
